summary: Eagle Point Credit Co Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) on May 22, 2026, to update its registration statement following its conversion from a Delaware corporation to a Delaware Statutory Trust. The conversion is a structural change with no acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven special situation. The company renamed to Eagle Point Credit Company, and each outstanding share of common and preferred stock converted into corresponding shares of beneficial interest under the same terms. The filing primarily describes the application of the Delaware Statutory Trust Act's control share statute and its voting thresholds. This is a routine corporate domicile change, not a special situation.
